articles.title: Spain’s PLD Space Raises €180 Million in Series C Funding
articles.summary:
Spanish rocket builder PLD Space has closed a €180 million Series C funding round led by Japanese satellite manufacturer Mitsubishi Electric Corporation, which has also committed to becoming a strategic customer. The company plans to use the funding to ramp up production capacity as it prepares for the inaugural flight of its MIURA 5 rocket […]

articles.title: PLD Space raises $209 million to shift into serial rocket production
articles.summary:
PLD Space has raised $209 million to ramp up production of the Spanish startup’s Miura 5 launch vehicle, marking the largest funding round for a European space company announced so far this year.
